# scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalMove.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalMove.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Validated traversal path of world-space body origins, played over duration.
Call bake() after changing points. Playback rechecks collision so moving
actors and doors can interrupt a path that was clear when planned.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### position_at

```gdscript
func position_at(s: float) -> Vector3
```

[Source:66](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalMove.gd#L66)

Samples clamped normalized distance s in 0..1 after bake().
Empty points return Vector3.ZERO; a zero-length path returns its final point.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `s` | `float` | required |

Return type: `Vector3`.
